name: Flex Your FPS And Ping!
desc:
🎮 Welcome to Flex Your FPS And Ping — But Better!

This is a hangout game mainly for flexing your FPS and Ping! 💥 However, the game has been extended to let you flex your platform (e.g., Android, iOS, and more ), your total friends, badges, and even your account age! 

More features will eventually come! 🚀


🛠️ Changelog:
Fixed some performance issues
Somewhat more easter eggs
